app.name: Specra
app.tagline: Notes, chat and retrieval on your own Postgres.

states.apiOfflineHint: Start it with cd apps/api && ./mvnw spring-boot:run

marketing.title: Your notes, answerable.
marketing.subtitle: Specra keeps notes in PostgreSQL, indexes them into pgvector, and answers questions from them with whichever model provider you point it at.

notes.title: Notes that stay yours
notes.body: CRUD through Spring Data JPA, paged and sorted on the server, rendered with TanStack Table.

rag.title: Retrieval, not guesswork
rag.body: Index a note and it is chunked, embedded and stored in pgvector. Answers cite the notes they came from.

providers.title: No vendor in the code
providers.body: Anthropic, OpenAI and Ollama are all on the classpath. Which one runs is one environment variable.

observability.title: Traceable by default
observability.body: Every response carries a request id and a trace id, and every error is an RFC 9457 problem document.

marketing.footerNote: A reference stack, not a product.
